method_original: train-only Q95(abs(stakeholder component)) / Q95(unweighted tracking loss)
retention_basis: Original historical scenario IDs were not archived. Independent review compared zero-action-prefix counterfactual re-evaluations on legacy versus frozen causal dynamics using alternative training-only selections. At 12 scenarios the compared values were equal to reported precision; at 48 they differed by 0.00006. The replacement quantile-sampling estimate varied materially with sample count (12, 48, 96), so replacing the original coefficient from that sample was rejected. No test-set model performance or policy reward was used to select a coefficient.
caution: Independent reviewer replays are transcribed from the supplied review; full replay logs were not provided. They are not claimed to reproduce the original archived calibration scenarios.
alternative_capacity_protocol: Hold the same lambda_c for 6/8 kW; recompute automatic economic normalisation and delta=0.1033/Lcap. Separate future sensitivity runs are not launched by this 7-kW script.
